answer: Deposit-forfeit reputation decay: an identity accrues a public pearl of verified work, but each new identity starts hollow until it pays a per-action deposit that decays only through sustained honest output. The rule forfeits that deposit on any flagged sybil link, so a farm's cost scales linearly with each fake identity rather than once per operator. Attackers must fund and risk a full reef of parallel deposits, making N identities cost N times the honest baseline.
